title.zh: 【Solana 基金会合并 SIMD-0567 提案，同时提出 CU 优化版 ATA 程序 p-ATA】
title.en: 【Solana 基金会合并 SIMD-0567 提案，同时提出 CU 优化版 ATA 程序 p-ATA】

current_state.zh: The Solana Foundation merged SIMD-0567 to swap the Associated Token Account Program for a Pinocchio-based, compute-unit-optimized p-ATA program using no-std design and zero-copy parsing, reporting roughly 35% lower wall-clock time with hash-verified migration and completed formal verification.
current_state.en: The Solana Foundation merged SIMD-0567 to swap the Associated Token Account Program for a Pinocchio-based, compute-unit-optimized p-ATA program using no-std design and zero-copy parsing, reporting roughly 35% lower wall-clock time with hash-verified migration and completed formal verification.
